svg.title: Which requests reach an address of the local network
svg.desc: A request of this app to the Paperless URL of the settings reaches an address of the local network when Paperless runs in my local network is selected, and then follows no redirect. Without the switch, Nextcloud refuses the address before any request leaves it, and saving says to select the switch. Requests of other apps keep Nextcloud's protection, unless allow_local_remote_servers in config.php lifts it for all of them.
